trends.name: Iran-Israel Military Escalation
trends.summary: Over 100 U.S. and Israeli fighter jets conducting most intense airstrikes against IRGC targets since war began, with Trump's Hormuz deadline intensifying geopolitical risk. Iran delivered 10-point peace plan but negotiations remain tenuous. This represents major supply shock risk to oil markets and broader economic growth.

trends.name: AI Chip Demand & Broadcom Expansion
trends.summary: Samsung profits seen jumping 8-fold on AI chip boom; Broadcom agrees expanded deals with Google and Anthropic (investing $200M in new PE venture). Signals explosive semiconductor sector growth driven by AI infrastructure buildout and sustained enterprise demand.

trends.name: Fed Rate Cut Expectations Collapse
trends.summary: Markets now pricing zero Fed rate cuts as most likely outcome for 2026, with Wells Fargo reversing prior call for two cuts. Reflects sticky inflation data and Fed's hawkish pivot, reshaping fixed income and equity valuation assumptions.

trends.name: Australian Inflation Surge
trends.summary: Melbourne Institute inflation jumped to 4.3% YoY (from 3.6%) and 1.3% MoM (from -0.2%), signaling broader Asia-Pacific inflationary pressures. Combined with mixed APAC market sentiment and job ads surge (3.1%), indicates regional stagflation risks.

trends.name: Oil Prices & Energy Market Volatility
trends.summary: Oil prices hold gains despite Trump Hormuz deadline approaching, as markets assess actual supply disruption risks versus geopolitical headlines. Strait of Hormuz ship traffic elevated but prices not reflecting severe supply shock—suggesting limited near-term production cuts feared.

trends.name: Tech Sector Employment Contraction
trends.summary: US tech sector lost 43,000 jobs over past year—largest YoY drop since early 2024, exceeding 2020 pandemic and 2008 financial crisis declines. Signals potential AI-driven displacement and sector retrenchment despite headline AI enthusiasm, raising recessionary concerns.

trends.name: Inflation Swap & Breakeven Rates
trends.summary: 1-year inflation swap rate at 3.24% reflecting real-time inflation expectations. Growing market adoption of inflation swaps over TIPS breakevens as more reliable metric amid sticky inflation data and Fed policy uncertainty.

trends.name: Medicare Advantage Payment Rate Boost
trends.summary: Trump administration finalizes better-than-feared Medicare Advantage payment rates, providing significant boost to health insurer margins and earnings outlooks. Regulatory tailwind for UnitedHealth, Humana, Elevance Health and sector valuations.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk Premium on Markets
trends.summary: South Korea's Kospi gave up 2.65% early gains to trade negative; Asia-Pacific markets mixed as investors assess Trump's Iran rhetoric. Volatility falling on ceasefire hopes but underlying caution remains, with war headline risk weighing on risk assets.

trends.name: Potential S&P 500 Index Changes
trends.summary: Surprise stock set to join S&P 500 index, signaling rotation opportunities and positioning adjustments. Reflects broader market recovery narrative and shifts in sector composition as stocks approach comeback phase.

trends.name: Software Sector Recovery Catalysts
trends.summary: After brutal stretch, three key factors emerging to reignite software stocks: potential rate cut trajectory softening, AI revenue acceleration, and valuation stabilization. Sector positioned for relief bounce if macro conditions ease.

trends.name: OpenAI vs Musk Antitrust Battle
trends.summary: OpenAI asks California, Delaware to investigate Musk's 'anti-competitive behavior' ahead of April trial. High-profile legal dispute adds regulatory uncertainty to AI sector and signals intensifying competition dynamics in generative AI market.
